title: Exceptional inverse image restricts to finite clopen source components
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\geq1$, as in [def-pur-conventions]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite disjoint open and closed cover, let $j_i:X_i\hookrightarrow X$ be its inclusions [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and put $g_i=g\circ j_i$. Use the pro-etale coefficient categories and operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the finite-clopen equivalences [lem-pur-finite-clopen-derived-decomposition], finite compact-support direct image [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and the constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

At each finite coefficient level $A=A_{E,n}$, for $K\in D^b_c(X,A)$ with components $K_i=Lj_i^*K$, there is a natural isomorphism
$$
 Rg_!K\simeq\bigoplus_{i\in I}R(g_i)_!K_i.
$$
For every $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ and $L\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ there are natural isomorphisms
$$
 Lj_i^*Rg^!L\simeq R(g_i)^!L.
$$
At finite level they are the right-adjoint comparisons for the displayed direct-sum decomposition. The same comparisons exist on the derived categories of strict etale coefficient systems used to construct the integral exceptional inverse image in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]; they commute with evaluation at each level and with the etale/pro-etale system comparison. The integral isomorphisms are their images under restriction of scalars and the derived inverse-limit functor on those actual systems, rather than a choice of a lift of a diagram in an ordinary derived category. The field isomorphisms are obtained by the rationalized and common-stage operations in that definition. For the coefficient unit $\Lambda_Y$ this gives $Lj_i^*\omega_g\simeq\omega_{g_i}$, where $\omega_g=Rg^!\Lambda_Y$ and $\omega_{g_i}=R(g_i)^!\Lambda_Y$. No smoothness, purity orientation, section or tensor invertibility is assumed. Empty components and the empty cover of the empty scheme are allowed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-clopen-common-compact-support] to $g$ and its cover. It supplies $c=(a,p)$ and $c_i=(a\circ j_i,p)$ with finite-dimensional common proper part, and gives $Rg_!K\cong\bigoplus_iR(g_i)_!Lj_i^*K$ on bounded constructible inputs, through the canonical compactification comparisons.

proof.text: The strict-system product equivalence and $b_{i,A}:F_{g,A}E_{i,A}\cong F_{g_i,A}$ are [lem-pur-clopen-strict-system-support]. Apply [lem-pur-clopen-counit-adjoint-comparison] to these and the finite comparison from Step 1. This gives the finite component right-adjoint isomorphisms and actual derived strict-system isomorphisms $r_{i,A}G_{g,A}\cong G_{g_i,A}$, with the prescribed counit equation and finite evaluations.

Its finite evaluations are the Step 2 comparisons; integral completed pullback is identified with component restriction there.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-clopen-exceptional-scalar-descent] to Step 3. Its finite-free scalar squares give the rationalized $E$-comparison and its common-stage $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ descent, with compatibility on morphisms and cofinal coefficient indices.

proof.text: At every coefficient stage set $L=\Lambda_Y$; the definition $\omega_g=Rg^!\Lambda_Y$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] gives $Lj_i^*\omega_g\cong\omega_{g_i}$. If $X_i=\varnothing$, restriction and exceptional image there are zero. If $I=\varnothing$, the cover gives $X=\varnothing$; [lem-pur-finite-clopen-derived-decomposition] gives $K=0$, and Step 1 identifies its image with the empty sum. No step requires smoothness, an orientation, a section or invertibility.
